correctness.rationale: At fixed t, stationarity makes J constant on the oriented ring, even when the chain is periodic. The ratios of stationary clockwise flow to reverse flow on each edge are all greater than, equal to, or less than 1 according to the sign of this same J. Their product cancels the stationary masses and equals R=∏ᵢpᵢ⁺/pᵢ⁻; row denominators and destination factors then cancel, leaving exactly the product of Gamma density ratios. Consequently log R=C+A log t−Bt and J=0 is equivalent to detailed balance. If AB>0 the two ends have sign opposite to A and the only extremum is at A/B; comparing the extremum with zero gives the exact two-root, tangency and no-root regimes, with Lambert W branches ordered by −A/B<0. If AB<0 the function is strictly monotone between opposite infinities. If A or B vanishes the separate logarithmic, linear or constant cases in the source exhaust the possibilities. Equal-mean Gamma(2,2) and Gamma(1,1) give 4t exp(−t), whose maximum 4/e exceeds 1 and whose two end limits are 0, yielding the sharp witness for every n≥3. The off-scope limitation claiming duration-independence of the weights is necessary is stronger than warranted: the same cancellation holds for positive destination-only qᵢ(t) at each fixed t. Pure self-loops likewise do not by themselves affect the sign argument if the off-diagonal scores remain as stated. Neither limitation affects the frozen theorem under its declared assumptions. CHECK.py was inspected, not run; the recorded numerical run is not independent proof.

value.rationale: The equal-mean example is a useful teaching illustration of the difference between density and mean, but in this model it just repeats two crossings of one elementary Gamma density ratio on every edge. The destination invariance is standard cycle cancellation, and the phase diagram follows by differentiation of a single scalar function. The result supplies no distinct network effect or sharper boundary within the motivating shared-rate model, where two reversals are impossible.
